name: Input
description: API for handling user input in a way that's compatible with all supported input devices (keyboards, mice, gamepads, and more!).
Inputs are defined as a set of Actions, collectively called an Action Set.
Each Action is bound to one or more physical buttons and/or analogue sensors, and carries a semantic meaning that should be adhered to.
This ensures players are free to configure their inputs how they want, on a range of devices, while still having a consistent experience across games and addons.
Action Sets can be selected on the fly to change how input behaves for players.
For example, switching to menu navigation when they open chat.

functions.name: switchToBasicActionSet
description: Switches the active action set to "Basic", which should support most 2D and 3D player characters.
If the player is using a mouse, their cursor is locked to the screen when switching to this action set.

functions.name: switchToMenuActionSet
description: Switches the active action set to "Menu", enabling the navigation of UIs.
Pass the optional `MenuType` enum to control which input will trigger the `dismissMenu` action.
If the player is using a mouse, their cursor is unlocked from the screen when switching to this action set.

parameters.name: menu
parameters.description: The (optional) menu type being switched to.

enums.name: MenuType
enums.description: Menu types which are opened by an action, and should be dismissed by the same action.

classes.name: DigitalAction
description: A digital action, i.e. a button press (but not necessarily bound to a physical button).
Note that none of these properties are mutually exclusive.
It is valid for a button to be pressed and released during, and held at the end of, a given input sample.

properties.name: wasPressedThisFrame
properties.description: True if the button transitioned from not pressed to pressed during this input sample

properties.name: wasReleasedThisFrame
properties.description: True if the button transitioned from pressed to not pressed during this input sample

properties.name: isHeld
properties.description: True if the button was held at the **end** of this input sample

classes.name: MenuActionSet
classes.description: A collection of actions available when the "Menu" action set is active.

properties.name: cursor
properties.description: The delta (in pixels) of the physical or virtual mouse cursor since the last time input was processed.

properties.name: scroll
properties.description: The delta of the scroll action since the last time input was processed.

properties.name: up
properties.description: Selects a focusable UI element immediately above the currently focused element

properties.name: down
properties.description: Selects a focusable UI element immediately below the currently focused element

properties.name: left
properties.description: Selects a focusable UI element immediately left of the currently focused element

properties.name: right
properties.description: Selects a focusable UI element immediately right of the currently focused element

properties.name: previousTab
properties.description: Selects the previous tab or page in the currently active window or modal

properties.name: nextTab
properties.description: Selects the next tab or page in the currently active window or modal

properties.name: activateCursor
properties.description: Clicks/presses an interactive UI element underneath the current cursor position

properties.name: affirm
properties.description: Affirms confirmation modals or clicks/presses the currently focused element

properties.name: cancel
properties.description: Cancels/closes modals or returns to the previous screen

properties.name: openContextMenu
properties.description: Opens a context menu or displays more information for the currently hovered/focused UI element

properties.name: hotkey1
properties.description: Generic action which can be used by developers for interactions not covered by the above actions

properties.name: hotkey2
properties.description: Generic action which can be used by developers for interactions not covered by the above actions

properties.name: hotkey3
properties.description: Generic action which can be used by developers for interactions not covered by the above actions

properties.name: hotkey4
properties.description: Generic action which can be used by developers for interactions not covered by the above actions

properties.name: dismissMenu
properties.description: Dismisses the currently open menu. Bound dynamically depending on the active menu type

classes.name: BasicActionSet
description: A collection of actions available when the "Basic" action set is active.
Useful for generic 2D/3D player character controllers and simple/arcade land, sea and air vehicles.

properties.name: look
properties.description: Adjusts the player's viewport on two axes

properties.name: move
properties.description: Moves the player on two axes. Length is clamped to one, but can be shorter

properties.name: jump
properties.description: Causes the player to perform an action they would expect to be bound to their jump button

properties.name: crouch
properties.description: Causes the player to perform an action they would expect to be bound to their crouch button

properties.name: sprint
properties.description: Causes the player to perform an action they would expect to be bound to their sprint button

properties.name: primary
properties.description: Causes the player to perform an action they would expect to be bound to the button usually used for shooting/attacking in FPS/TPS games

properties.name: secondary
properties.description: Causes the player to perform an action they would expect to be bound to the button usually used for aiming in FPS/TPS games

properties.name: previousItem
properties.description: Selects the previous item/weapon held by the player

properties.name: nextItem
properties.description: Selects the next item/weapon held by the player

properties.name: reload
properties.description: Causes the player to reload/recharge their item/weapon.

properties.name: interact
properties.description: Causes the player to interact with the object they're looking at (e.g. entering a vehicle)

properties.name: openInventory
properties.description: Opens the player's inventory (if relevant to the type of game or addon you're building)

properties.name: openMainMenu
properties.description: Should always open the main in-game menu (usually a pause menu in singleplayer games)

properties.name: openSocialMenu
properties.description: Opens a menu used for social features in multiplayer (e.g. chat)

properties.name: hotkey1
properties.description: Generic action which can be used by developers for interactions not covered by the above actions

events.name: menuActionSet
description: Fired every time input is processed while the "Menu" action set is active.
- In the menu, this is fired **every frame**
- In games on the client, this is fired **once per server tick** for the local player
- This action set does not exist on the server

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: A snapshot of the menu actions this frame/tick.

parameters.name: deltaTime
parameters.description: Seconds passed since the last time input was processed (including for other action sets)

events.name: basicActionSetPredicted
description: Fired in the menu and games on the client every time input is processed while the "Basic" action set is active.
- In the menu, this is fired **every frame**
- In games, this is fired **once per server tick** for each player and **when performing local prediction**
On the server, the `"basicActionSet"` event is fired instead.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player these inputs are for.

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: A snapshot of the basic actions this frame/tick.

parameters.name: isFirstTimePredicted
parameters.description: True if this is the first time we're processing this input

parameters.name: deltaTime
parameters.description: Seconds passed since the last time input was processed (including for other action sets)

events.name: basicActionSet
description: Fired on the server every time input is processed while the "Basic" action set is active.
On the client, the `"basicActionSetPredicted"` event is fired instead.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player these inputs are for.

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: A snapshot of the basic actions this frame/tick.

parameters.name: deltaTime
parameters.description: Seconds passed since the last time input was processed (including for other action sets)
